《Metal Thunder》是由Dumbbell Games工作室研发的一款有肉鸽元素的战争军事射击游戏，本质上应该是款塔防游戏。玩家作为一名美军空中炮艇AC-130战机的驾驶员，将在基地上空盘旋，守卫基地的安全，消灭前来进攻的敌人们。 [h2]游戏玩法[/h2] 游戏目前只有生存模式，玩家需要在不同的场景规定时间内中守护住不同的任务目标（但是本质还是保护基地，没有太大的区别）。你驾驶着AC-130重型战斗直升机，可以用各种武器消灭敌人，最开始只有30MM的机枪，每当消灭敌人都会获得经验值和金钱。 升级后可以3选1选择强化，可以解锁新的武器，例如45MM、102MM，加特林、弹道、无人机等各种强大的武器，也可以在现有的装备上进行升级，例如减少装填武器速度，增加弹夹最大的容量上限，武器伤害等，甚至可以解锁同时发射多枚子弹等高稀有度的升级。 不仅如此，玩家还可以利用金钱购买友军单位协助防守基地。最开始可以召唤士兵帮忙防守，随着等级的提升，还能解锁装甲车、坦克甚至是直升机，玩家还可以利用指令操作己方单位防守还是进攻。 游戏还加入了排行榜系统，玩家可以跟全球其他玩家一起，竞争击杀数，射击的准确率等等，加入了一定的挑战性。 [h2]游玩感想[/h2] 本作目前处于EA阶段，游戏内容比较少，只有生存模式，总共只有6张地图，并且后面的地图还需要靠击杀敌军数量来解锁，比较单调。并且游玩的内容也比较重复，除了升级的选项有所不同，可以解锁不同新的武器以外，每局的内容都大差不差。 但是游戏的创意还是不错的，在武装直升机上塔防，还加入了肉鸽和兵种的元素，希望后续可以增加更多可玩内容。游戏也预告将在后续推出战役模式，非常期待。 [h2]总结[/h2] 总的来说，这是一款比较有新意的塔防肉鸽元素，游戏采用军事题材，并且让玩家化身武装战斗机，击溃源源不断的敌人，敌人也会随着波数越来越强，出动装甲车坦克等，有一定的挑战性。但是目前游戏内容较少，希望后续可以不断更新补充，喜欢军事或者塔防类型的玩家可以尝试~ [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

It's cool, just not ready yet I'm aware this is early access, so please take what I say with a grain of salt. The dev is VERY active and seems to be making updates at a quite impressive pace. This will be a really cool game, but at the current moment it has some performance issues. Once you upgrade the guns a bit to where they have more splash damage, more rounds fired per click etc the FPS just goes down the toilet. To the point it is hardly playable. I have a pretty beefy rig, intel 13900K, rtx 3090ti etc but optimization is still a factor If the game was less fun I'd actually feel better cause I could just quit playing, but it's a really really cool game so I sadly just have to put it on the shelf for a while until they get that stuff ironed out. If you were in the market today I'd say to add to wishlist but give it a bit. At the rate the dev is updating things I'm quite sure it will be resolved soon though

Do you remember the fun of achieving an AC 130 kill streak in MW2 (2009, not the trash remake)? If yes Metal Thunder is what you need in your life. When I got this from a Fanatical bundle I wasn't expecting much, but color me surprised. Even for an early access title what is here is fun. Dare I say, I wouldn't even mind paying $10.99 for it. Vampire Survivors-esque vehicular combat- bombing extremists in the middle east is what is offered here as the campaign is still unreleased. The upgrades feel powerful and iterative. I would like to see more offered for the asking price (i.e. campaign, more build variety, more settings), but at the end of the day this is a simple good time in 30 minute-1hr increments. If you're not looking for anything more you should've stopped reading this review after the first sentence.

前期：不就是坐在天上打打靶子么，EZ 中期：叛军买得起这么多坦克？ 后期：这真的是叛军？！（漫天的MI28/MI24，地上全是T-72） 好玩还是挺好玩的，期待做完，武器也多一些 顺便写一下个人的武器心得吧，仅代表个人观点 30炮：也就前期用用了，抽到6连发之前就是FW，抽到6连发之后再叠一下射速和弹容清步兵还是很快的 45炮：30炮pro plus版，但和30一样，也就是清步兵的命了 102炮：装填捉急，敲不动坦克，下坠大，弹速慢，但是小图打步战车和步兵挺好用 转轮炮：这位更是重量级 Comet：伤害低，溅射小，完全意义不明，但凡把下坠取消也不至于见到秒切 地狱火：线控导弹，但一发砸不死坦克，清步兵效率又低，装填也慢，我能想到唯一的场景就是砸步战车和直升机了 小牛：你和那个地狱火嗷，你俩就是那个舒克和贝塔 JDAM：叠范围，叠范围就对了！ 集束炸弹：唯一神，一键移除一切单位，装填也快，但前提是得会拉准星，不要集中一个点炸 白磷弹：封路用的低伤害版集束炸弹，但是有下坠，大图慎用 凝固汽油弹：一炸炸一片，还附带大范围燃烧，单入口据点最后的防线，但装填的速度比我命都长

Then the crashing wouldnt be that bad, but till either that system is added or the crashing is fixed. I dont see the point of playing this game right now.

Completed all maps within 5 hours, most of my runs are god runs, only one of the guns is usable, can get repetitive quickly. Definitely a play once and forget type of game. Full price is pushing it. Maybe worth it on sale. Hell if youre fast enough you might even be able to complete it in 2 hours then refund it. (Its basically a demo right now) A game like this has lots of potential: escort missions, destructible environment, base building/rts elements, methodical cover fire. However I don't think thats the direction the devs are going here. It's definitely screaming vampire survivors more than anything else. Once you hit endgame (again within 5 hours) its less about precisely landing your shots and more about violently waving your mouse around spamming 40mm at the red squares hoping your shots will hit while readjusting for shots at enemies on different parts of the map. Bottom line, If that original Modern Warfare mission is giving you a flirty kiss as you look at this game, maybe look elsewhere, or wait a bit. Its a rogue like not a military strategy game. It's not a bad game by any stretch, but what it is trying to be and what it could be are not certain at this point. Who knows what the devs will do with it.

Slop in the true sense of the word: every idea in this game is poorly thought out, half baked, and thrown in without consideration for how it will mix with the others. I suppose an AC130 firing hundreds of cannon rounds per minute can be entertaining for a short while, but that's about it: every weapon having access to the same exact upgrades as every other weapon doesn't help, whatever you choose you'll end up with laggy rapid fire AoE spam. Dishonorable mention to enemy spawns in particular: the spawn points are very blatant, activate the millisecond you look away, and vomit out so many enemies at once the pathfinding can't keep up and the whole blob just stays there for up to half a minute.

Edit: The developer has come back from a hiatus and responded to this review, as well as finally releasing an update regarding the game's delay. Please read the developer's response as well as the update that got posted. I'm holding off on changing this to a positive review pending obvious effort returning to development. _________________________________________________ Here's the thing. I enjoyed each of the 6 or so hours I played. The game is relatively cheap. So maybe this should be a positive review. Except, there's a roadmap, and the details in the Early Access section clearly state that there will be active development of the game, new weapons, new missions, work on a campaign mode for 1.0, etc. Everything sounds like there will be more content during Early Access, with a 1.0 launch in 6-12 months (Nov 2025 will be 12 months) and then post 1.0 support. But there have been no updates since May 2025. Nothing. No news posts or anything. You know what there has been? A "game"/"productivity tool" called DriveWave, with a demo released August 2025, by the same developer as this. Is it a neat little side project the dev is doing as a break to regain focus on Metal Thunder? Who knows. The devs haven't posted anything. It almost seems like they're treating it as their first project rather than this one. It's very strange. So this fully appears to be an abandonware game at this point, with the dev moving on to do something completely different. As such, while it is very neat, it's an unrealized concept, and I cannot recommend it at all on principle.

For some reason, the units in this game are highly detailed, even though that adds no value at all in a game like this. The most practical way to play is with thermal vision enabled anyway. On top of that, the visual effects seem unnecessarily demanding, and it's not clear what purpose they serve. That said, I doubt they're the actual cause of the FPS drops. There seems to be something wrong with the optimization. My guess is that unit pathfinding is being triggered too frequently, and there may be some engine limitation related to it. As a result, after about 10 minutes of gameplay, half of the enemy units just stand still. In short, developer, spend some time reading the engine documentation, get AI to help if necessary, finish the core game first, and only then move on to the campaign, zombie mode, and everything else.

It has the makings of a good game, the bones they have honed perfectly. You truly feel like an AC-130 changing the battlefield. But there's no flesh on it. You also aren't challenged. Only once did I get damaged on my base because I purposefully was limiting myself to 35mm upgrades. And I can't bump it up in difficulty as it doesn't count towards stuff. I'd recommend you wait to buy it. Keep it wishlisted but wait for more updates. Now, I'm not one normally to post a review without input (As of recently) to solve the problem so I'll stand true I heavily recommend that the devs focus more on the original flesh before moving onto campaign and zombies. Add unique enemies per map, actually add elites and bosses, and maybe unique ground spawns as well. Fighting the same Infantry, Technical, APC, Tank, and Helicopters is boring. I also recommend you focus on the AI. Many times when I was playing (This was most egregious in the second map of endless) the AI would stutter step or not advance at all. Allies would also get stuck and wig out (On the second to last map i had an MLRS floating and teleporting around).

Instead of following the game’s planned progression, the dev team keeps focusing on nerfing player power and slowing progress through currency and upgrade restrictions. In this recent shooting patch, the only change that’s strongly noticeable is the update to game currency—gun upgrades now take far too long, so progression feels stalled and unrewarding. The result isn’t “more challenge,” it’s a tedious, frustrating grind where meaningful upgrades barely come and bug fixes or real gameplay improvements don’t show up. Nerf patches don’t make the game more attractive—they just frustrate players, reduce enjoyment, and create regret for anyone who spent money expecting the experience to improve. Meanwhile, other game modes are advertised but delayed with excuses and apologies, which only adds to the sense that effort is going into damage control instead of delivering actual content and fixing what’s broken. At this point, it’s no wonder players hardly return after patches that ruin pacing and progression rather than enhancing the shooting experience.
